projects.description: AI-powered interview preparation platform with a microservices backend for auth, resume, interview, billing and roadmap services.
lines: # ShreyanshPrepAI
### AI-powered interview preparation platform with a microservices backend for auth, resume, interview, billing and roadmap services.
Architected a full-stack interview preparation platform with Groq-hosted
LLMs via LangChain for PDF-based resume analysis, ATS-style feedback,
personalized interview questions and learning roadmaps. Stateful LangGraph
workflows handle conditional routing for interview generation, answer
evaluation and report generation, while Firebase Google Auth, MongoDB and
Redis handle identity, storage and caching.
Built with React · Node.js · Express.js · MongoDB · Redis · LangChain · LangGraph · Groq API · Firebase · Docker
[Visit](https://github.com/shreyansh018/ShreyanshPrepAI)

projects.description: Agentic RAG pipeline with multi-step reasoning, history-aware query planning and conversational memory.
lines: # Enterprise Agentic RAG
### Agentic RAG pipeline with multi-step reasoning, history-aware query planning and conversational memory.
Built an agentic RAG pipeline with LangGraph for multi-step reasoning,
conversational routing and persistent conversation memory. Document
ingestion and semantic retrieval use Qdrant Cloud and Gemini embeddings
(3072 dimensions) with FlashRank reranking. NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails filter
off-topic queries, jailbreaks and prompt injection, while Portkey Gateway
provides centralized LLM orchestration with primary and fallback Groq
configurations. Includes a FastAPI backend, Streamlit interface and
RAGAS/LangSmith evaluation workflows.
Built with Python · FastAPI · LangChain · LangGraph · Qdrant · Groq API · NeMo Guardrails · LangSmith · RAGAS · Streamlit
[Visit](https://github.com/shreyansh018/Enterprise-RAG-Application)
